nameOrigin: a herb (referring to cooking and its Grass type)

pokedexEntries.bk: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.

pokedexEntries.wh: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: It’s good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It’s kind enough to share them with friends.
